hints.title: Zero Vowel Case
hints.text: If the string contains zero vowels, Alice cannot make any valid initial move and loses immediately.

hints.title: Odd Vowel Count
hints.text: If the total vowel count is odd, Alice can remove the entire string on her very first move to win.

hints.title: Even Vowel Count
hints.text: If the total vowel count is even and positive, Alice can remove a prefix with an odd number of vowels, leaving Bob with an odd number of vowels from which Bob cannot eliminate all remaining vowels in one move.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Early returns on encountering the first vowel.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Game tree search is unnecessarily complex when win invariants are determinable in a single scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derives the game-theoretic winning condition: Alice wins if and only if at least one vowel exists.
